Methylene blue injection (ProvayBlue) is a medicament put up in measured doses/for retail sale, so it falls in heading 3004. Methylene blue is a thiazine dye, a heterocyclic compound with nitrogen and sulfur, and its bulk form is classified in 2934. The finished injection is in 3004.90. The 3004.90 subheadings include 3004.90.92 ("Other" under "Other"), and the statistical suffix 3004.90.9290 is a catch-all. Earlier suffixes, such as 3004.90.91 and 3004.90.92, cover other medicaments. I'm going with 3004.90.9290, though I haven't checked it against the current schedule.
